args: Image files are stored in S3 under photos/<user_id>/<photo_id>; never on local disk.
Photo ids are UUIDv7 values generated in app/ids.py.
Thumbnails are 320 pixels on the long edge.
Background tasks are Celery tasks in app/tasks.py with acks_late enabled.
User-facing strings go through gettext in app/i18n.py.
Uploads larger than 25 MB are rejected with HTTP 413.
Feature flags are read from app/flags.py, never from environment variables directly.

steps.prompt: Add rate limiting to the upload endpoint in app/photos.py.
steps.final: Uploads are limited to 30 a minute per user in app/photos.py, answering 429 past that. 40 passed.
